title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta20

## Backend Map snapshot image for notifications

This beta adds a server-side latest-map PNG intended for Home Assistant
notifications, Node-RED and other automations that must work without an open
Lovelace dashboard.

### Map snapshot image

- Add one Home Assistant **Map snapshot** `image` entity per mower.
- Render a cached PNG on the Home Assistant backend from the current decoded map,
  ZoneLedger/VendorTrailStore-owned current cycle, current mower position/heading
  and charging station.
- PNG is used deliberately so the snapshot is a general-purpose Home Assistant
  image resource: it can be reused by dashboards, `/api/image_proxy/...`,
  mobile notifications, Node-RED and other automations without depending on SVG
  support in each client.
- Include zones, Off-limit, VF-off, Gate areas, available Channels, current-cycle
  mowing geometry, a thin live-route overlay and zone labels.
- Keep the snapshot independent from Navimower Map Card; no dashboard/browser
  needs to be open.
- The initial release intentionally has no geographic tile underlay. Map
  georeference/underlay rendering remains a separate frontend concern.

### Bounded automatic refresh

- While mowing, paused or returning, rebuild the cached PNG at most once every
  60 seconds.
- Rebuild immediately when the mower activity/state/error/docked state or map
  revision changes.
- Do not run a periodic image renderer while the mower is idle/docked.
- Normal image-proxy reads serve the latest cached PNG. A cold first request may
  create the initial image, but repeated HTTP reads do not trigger rerenders.

### Automation / Node-RED refresh

Add `navimower.refresh_map_snapshot`.

The action waits until the new PNG has replaced the cache, so an automation can:

1. call `navimower.refresh_map_snapshot` for the mower;
2. after that action completes, send a notification using the mower's Map
   snapshot entity URL, for example
   `/api/image_proxy/image.my_mower_map_snapshot`.

When multiple Navimower mowers are configured, pass `device_id` as with the
other mower-scoped Navimower actions.

### Implementation safety

- Snapshot rendering consumes the current integration-owned trail/cycle sources;
  it does not introduce a second reset/cycle resolver.
- Pillow work runs in Home Assistant's executor and the latest successful PNG is
  retained if a later render fails.
- Existing map-card rendering, progress, trails, Schedule and mower control
  behavior are unchanged.
